title: GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams
description: GitHub launched public preview of Copilot integration in Slack, bringing agentic coding help directly into team conversations for planning changes, investigating issues, and triaging bugs. Also introduced shared agentic work with GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams.

title: Codex CLI 0.149.0
description: Added an interactive codex agents dashboard for searching, starting, opening, renaming, and stopping tasks. Added /cd, /pwd, and /cwd commands for managing working directory. Added codex queue for sending messages to existing sessions. Expanded Vim editing with character replacement and change motions. Codex doctor now diagnoses endpoint protection, network/proxy failures, desktop app state, and update connectivity. SDK users can pass exact CLI config overrides and select max or ultra reasoning effort.

title: Cloud Agents and Cursor Harness Improvements
description: Cursor continues to improve cloud agents and the Cursor harness so always-on agents can operate as a system, building and shipping software on their own. New features include Subscriptions for monitoring PRs and Slack threads, Custom Modes for using any skill as a pinned mode, Subagents on isolated virtual machines, /goal command for long-lived objectives, Origin Code Hosting in early beta, Cloud Agents starting 3x faster with Builds, Google Workspace Plugins for Gmail/Drive/Calendar, and Cursor for iPad.

title: Gemini CLI v0.57.0-preview.0
description: Features new tool call formatter, integrated failure handling, and other experimental features.

Complaints about Gemini and its CLI - users reported issues including increased thinking time, problems with change management, and failures in detecting issues between updates

title: Grok 4.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash Now Available
description: Grok 4.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash models are now available in GitHub Copilot, expanding model options for developers.

title: Agent Plugins 1.0 Release
description: Agent Plugins 1.0 launched in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the Copilot app, enabling extensible agent capabilities.

title: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash and Copilot Memory Features
description: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot. Copilot memory and Ollama support added in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains. Copilot code review effort levels are generally available.

title: GitLab Support in Codex Cloud (Beta)
description: GitLab support is available in beta on all ChatGPT plans. Connect a GitLab project to Codex cloud, create an environment for it, start tasks from issues or merge requests with @codex, and request one-off or automatic merge request reviews.

title: Gemini CLI v0.55.1 Stable Release
description: Includes enhanced authentication & security features, model fallback & history improvements.

title: Linux Desktop Preview and Agent Imports
description: The ChatGPT desktop app for Linux is available in preview for supported Ubuntu, Debian, and Fedora desktop distributions. The desktop app also supports importing setup and recent work from Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Cursor. Codex CLI can import supported setup and recent chats from Claude Code and Cursor with /import.

title: Kimi K3 Model and Copilot Cloud Agent Reasoning
description: Kimi K3 is now available in GitHub Copilot. Users can customize the reasoning level for Copilot cloud agent and trigger Copilot automations with comments.

title: Skill and Plugin Security Scanning (Beta)
description: Enterprise plans can now turn on skill and plugin security scanning to automatically check third-party skills and plugins for malicious content when someone uploads or edits them.
